title: ClawMMU: Protection-Coherent Virtual Memory for Stateful LLM Agents
titleZh: ClawMMU：给有状态智能体的记忆加上权限边界
summary: Agent harnesses do not record who may act on long-term memory, so an instruction hidden in a fetched page can be treated as the user's own. ClawMMU labels every memory with owner, scope, origins, and authority, and checks the labels whenever content enters context, is written, returns from storage, or drives a tool call.
summaryZh: 给长期记忆的每一条内容标注所有者、作用域、来源和权限，并在写入、读回、进入上下文、触发工具四个边界检查这些标签。核心规则是“权限可以上升，但不能自己给自己升权”，从而把网页或工具结果里的越权指令变成运行框架可以阻断的保护错误。
why: 把记忆安全从提示词层拉回到运行框架层，给出了四个可检查的边界。

security.note: 在记忆读写与工具执行边界检查 owner / scope / origins / authority 标签。

evidence: 预印本 · 原文可核验

title: Disclosure Begets Disclosure: A Self-Reinforcing Privacy Loop in LLM Agents with Persistent Memory
titleZh: 记忆会反过来诱导披露：持久记忆中的隐私循环
summary: In multi-session simulations with 24 personal attributes, memory improves answer quality but also raises empirical leakage. Memory-conditioned responses carry earlier values forward as presuppositions; users affirm or leave them uncorrected, and the loop reinforces itself.
summaryZh: 在多会话客服模拟中，持久记忆提高回答质量，也让用户个人属性的可推断泄漏随会话增加；原因是智能体的预设和暗示被用户默认接受，又被写回记忆，形成自我强化的披露循环。限制智能体主动陈述或预设属性，比过滤用户输入或存储内容更能兼顾质量与隐私。
why: 把隐私风险从“存储泄露”扩展到“对话诱导披露”，并给出可操作的干预点。

security.note: 比较限制回答预设、过滤用户输入、匿名化存储三类干预的泄漏与质量权衡。

evidence: 预印本 · 原文可核验

title: PROVISO: Provenance-Informed Action Selection for Secure LLM Agents
titleZh: PROVISO：把来源类型带进工具动作选择
summary: PROVISO encodes trusted observations, external observations, the proposed action, and an alternative into provenance-typed memory, then commits the action with the highest calibrated value learned from outcomes. It reports gains on SkillsBench and ToolSafe.
summaryZh: 在工具动作执行前，把可信观察、外部内容、候选动作和替代动作编码成带来源类型的记忆，用结果学习出的校准价值选择要提交的动作。论文在 SkillsBench、ToolSafe 等任务上报告安全与效用收益；它训练的是动作选择控制器，不是专用记忆模型。
why: 来源类型进入动作选择，而不是只在检索时做相关性排序。

security.note: 将可信观察与外部观察分开编码，并把替代动作纳入比较。

evidence: 预印本 · 原文可核验

title: After the Attacker Leaves: Benchmarking Carryover Attacks on LLM Agents
titleZh: 攻击者离开之后：跨会话残留攻击基准
summary: CarryoverBench separates a one-time indirect prompt injection into two stages: planting a payload in a long-lived memory file or scheduled task, then triggering it in a later session. Across five frontier models, successfully planted payloads show no measurable decay within five turns.
summaryZh: 把一次性间接提示注入写入长期记忆文件或定时任务后、跨会话再次触发的风险，拆成“植入”和“触发”两阶段基准。五个前沿模型上，成功植入的载荷在五轮内没有出现可测衰减；作者据此主张需要运行时的持久状态控制，而不只是提示层防御。
why: 评测的是攻击载荷在会话结束后的存活，而不是单轮拦截率。

security.note: 以记忆文件与定时任务为植入通道，测量多轮后的触发与衰减。

evidence: 预印本 · 原文可核验

title: OptionWorld: A Benchmark for Diagnosing Failures of LLMs as Long-Term Personal Assistants
titleZh: OptionWorld：诊断长期个人助理为什么没把事做完
summary: Long-term assistants must follow unfinished tasks across days as information and circumstances change. OptionWorld links information acquisition, judgment, action, and outcome, and shows failures include not connecting facts to unfinished tasks, missing deadlines, and treating assumptions as real constraints.
summaryZh: 把跨天个人助理任务拆成信息获取、判断、行动和结果四个环节，定位“记住了事实却没完成任务”的原因。失败不只来自缺信息，还包括没有把事实连接到未完成事项、错过行动期限，以及把自己的假设当成真实限制。
why: 把长期记忆评测从问答正确率推向任务闭环。
evidence: 预印本 · 原文可核验

title: Cache Engineering for Agents
titleZh: Cache Engineering：把工作记忆管到 KV 缓存里
summary: Cache Engineering lets agents drop and reopen segments of the active KV cache instead of rewriting history and re-prefilling. An execution engine supports state restoration and reuse; rolling-drop policies are evaluated on task performance and cost.
summaryZh: 让智能体直接对活跃 KV 缓存做 drop / reopen 操作，避免改写历史前缀后重复预填充，并配套支持状态恢复与复用的执行引擎。论文在任务表现和成本之间评估滚动丢弃策略，再用递归自我改进优化缓存管理规则；这是工作记忆控制，不是单纯扩显存。
why: 把“记忆管理”落到推理时的 KV 缓存操作和成本。
evidence: 预印本 · 原文可核验

title: Industrial ReMEmbR: Scaling Spatiotemporal Memory to Robot Fleets
titleZh: Industrial ReMEmbR：把时空记忆扩展到机器人集群
summary: Robot fleets upload video retrieval representations, visual tokens, and reconstruction latents; a server generates descriptions on demand, and agents retrieve by content, location, and time. The system zeroes detected person regions to reduce personal information retention.
summaryZh: 为仓库机器人集群建立共享时空记忆：机器人上传视频检索表示、视觉 token 和重建潜变量，服务器按需生成描述，智能体按内容、位置和时间检索。系统通过识别人像区域并置零减少个人信息保留；论文报告缓存 token 解码在 450 次测试中复现未拆分模型的输出，但这不等于独立的隐私合规认证。
why: 把多机器人时空记忆做成可检索服务，同时暴露了隐私处理的边界。

security.note: 通过人像区域置零减少个人信息留存；作者报告解码一致性测试，未做独立合规认证。

evidence: 预印本 · 原文可核验

title: EventSync: Event-Driven Memory Updates for History-Dependent Manipulation
titleZh: EventSync：确认完成后再写入操作记忆
summary: EventSync uses a VLM planner, an action model, and a lightweight monitor that combines images and end-effector trajectories to confirm a subgoal is complete before writing it to memory. This reduces treating an attempt as a completed state.
summaryZh: 用事件驱动方式维护机器人已完成子目标的历史：VLM 规划、动作模型执行，轻量监测器结合图像和末端轨迹确认完成后才写入记忆。这样减少把“正在尝试”误记为“已经完成”的状态错误，并在仿真和真实操作任务中验证。
why: 记忆写入时机被显式建模，解决了长程操作里的状态幻觉。
evidence: 预印本 · 原文可核验

title: OpenVLHarness: Real World Visual Agentic Tool-Use with Multimodal Memory
titleZh: OpenVLHarness：把工具证据存成可组合的多模态记忆
summary: OpenVLHarness stores images, structured data, and web evidence produced by tools in an addressable multimodal memory, and lets code compose evidence across tools. The authors compare models on 22 benchmarks and report an average gain over a no-tool baseline.
summaryZh: 把工具产生的图像、结构化数据和网页证据存进可寻址的多模态记忆，并允许代码跨工具组合证据。作者在 22 个基准上比较多种模型，报告相对无工具基线的平均分提升；这说明保留和复用外部证据有助于视觉推理。
why: 多模态记忆不只是存图，而是把证据变成可组合的工具输出。
evidence: 预印本 · 原文可核验

title: SENRI: Understanding the Space-Event Nexus in Real-Life Videos
titleZh: SENRI：把“发生过什么”和“发生在哪里”对应起来
summary: SENRI-Bench builds event-space cross-query tasks from long egocentric videos. SENRI-Agent organizes local visual re-checks around a target and writes verified results into working memory without changing long-term memory.
summaryZh: SENRI-Bench 从长时间第一视角视频构造“事件—空间”互查任务，测试智能体能否把发生过的事与具体位置对应起来。配套 SENRI-Agent 按目标组织局部视觉复查，把核验结果写入工作记忆，而不改动原有长期记忆。
why: 把空间记忆和事件记忆放在同一个检索任务里考。
evidence: 预印本 · 原文可核验

title: MEMORA: A Memory-Enhanced Multimodal Committee Reranking Agent for Reasoning-Intensive Retrieval
titleZh: MEMORA：用情景记忆反过来调检索策略
summary: MEMORA decomposes a complex query into intent factors, combines multimodal committee reranking with cross-query episodic memory, and adjusts later retrieval priorities based on which factors worked before. It reports text and multimodal retrieval gains on MM-BRIGHT.
summaryZh: 把复杂查询拆成多个意图因素，结合多模态委员会重排和跨查询情景记忆，依据过去因素判断的效果调整后续检索优先级；同时微调面向推理的文档检索器。论文在 MM-BRIGHT 上报告文本和多模态检索收益。
why: 用情景记忆反过来调检索策略，而不是每次查询都从零开始。
evidence: 预印本 · 原文可核验

title: Training the Whole Agent, Not Just the Model
titleZh: 训练整个智能体，而不只是模型
summary: HarnessAdapt-RL uses training trajectories to generate repair skills and evolve tools and hooks, so policy training and harness experience accumulate together. Some skill gains internalize into the policy, while evolved tools still help at deployment.
summaryZh: HarnessAdapt-RL 用训练轨迹持续生成修复技能并演化工具和钩子，让策略训练与运行框架的经验积累互相反馈。实验显示部分技能收益可以内化到策略，而演化工具在部署时仍有作用；这是整体智能体和程序知识的联合改进，不是独立记忆模型训练。
why: 把“经验”写进 harness，而不只是写进模型权重。
evidence: 预印本 · 原文可核验

title: A Survey of Agent Memory in the Second Half: Towards Self-Evolving and Long-Horizon Agents
titleZh: 下半场的智能体记忆：走向自演化与长时任务
summary: The survey organizes agent memory along carriers, cognitive functions, and service subjects, covering writing, reading, updating, and memory-policy learning. It treats self-evolution and long-horizon tasks as system goals.
summaryZh: 从记忆载体、认知功能和服务主体三个维度梳理智能体记忆，讨论写入、读取、更新与记忆策略学习。它把自演化和长时任务作为系统目标，并提醒不同架构和评测范围需要分别理解。
why: 给“agent memory”划了一个可讨论的坐标系。

title: A Survey on Long-Term Memory Security in LLM Agents: Attacks, Defenses, and Governance Across the Memory Lifecycle
titleZh: 长期记忆安全综述：沿生命周期看攻防与治理
summary: The survey follows writing, storage, retrieval, execution, sharing, and forgetting/rollback, and proposes a verifiable memory governance framework. Provenance, versioning, permissions, and recoverability are treated as storage-stage design concerns.
summaryZh: 沿写入、存储、检索、执行、共享传播和遗忘回滚梳理长期记忆攻防，提出可验证记忆治理框架，强调来源、版本、权限和可恢复性应该从存储阶段就纳入设计。
why: 安全综述把生命周期作为主线，适合作为专题入口。

security.note: 以生命周期组织攻击、防御与治理，强调可验证性。

title: Seeing, Maintaining, and Learning: The Evolution of Multimodal Agent Memory
titleZh: 看见、保持、学习：多模态智能体记忆的演化
summary: The survey uses two axes to organize multimodal agent memory: how information is formed and represented, and how management changes with experience. It provides a framework for comparing system evolution paths.
summaryZh: 用两个轴梳理多模态智能体记忆：信息如何形成与表示，以及管理方式如何随经验变化。它为比较不同系统的演化路线提供了一个分析框架。
why: 多模态记忆的综述坐标，适合和 SENRI、MEMORA 一起读。

title: Defending AI Agent Memory Against Persistent Prompt Injection
titleZh: 防御通过智能体记忆实现的持久提示注入
summary: The author proposes schema filtering, an isolated summarization component, and tool authorization to limit persistent prompt injection through agent memory. A 500-attempt workflow test is reported, but the post does not provide enough public reproduction detail.
summaryZh: 作者分析外部工具内容进入情景记忆后，如何在后续会话或子智能体中触发未授权操作，并提出结构校验、隔离的记忆整理器和工具调用权限检查。文中报告一组 500 次攻击测试，但缺少公开可复现细节，应视为作者报告，而不是已独立验证的防御结论。
why: 把持久注入的攻击面写清楚，但证据等级是作者报告，不是论文。

security.note: 作者自述 500 次工作流测试，未提供公开复现细节。

evidence: 媒体报道 · 作者报告

title: MemCurrent: Designing Persistent Memory for Production Agents
titleZh: MemCurrent：生产环境智能体的持久记忆设计
summary: MemCurrent combines episodic traces and derived memories through automatic plugins, agent-directed tools, and offline consolidation. Databricks reports improved accuracy and efficiency on internal enterprise tasks.
summaryZh: Databricks 介绍 MemCurrent：把原始经历和提炼记忆结合，由插件自动记录上下文、工具即时读写、离线“梦境”流程整合和更新知识，已用于 Agent Bricks Memory 和 Genie。官方报告在内部企业任务上相较无记忆设置提高通过率并减少 token；结果受其数据和配置限制。
why: 工业界把“原始轨迹 + 提炼记忆 + 离线整合”做成了产品路径。
evidence: 官方博客 · 内部评测

title: 百度搭子发布多项新能力，加速AI进入企业生产场景
titleZh: 百度搭子：知识库、看板与记忆系统一起进企业
source: 国际金融报（东方财富转载）
summary: The report describes Baidu Dazi combining enterprise knowledge bases, work boards, and a memory system that preserves confirmed personalization requirements, while members and agents share context and hand off tasks. No memory-write mechanism or independent evaluation is disclosed.
summaryZh: 百度搭子把企业知识库、工作看板与记忆系统结合，分别保存规范依据、任务进度和已确认的个性化要求，让成员与智能体共享背景并接力执行任务。报道同时介绍操作授权与隔离部署，但没有披露记忆写入机制或独立评测结果。
why: 中文企业 Agent 的记忆产品化样本，但缺少可核验的技术细节。

title: 豆包工作迎来五项更新，本地Word也能直接打开编辑了
titleZh: 豆包工作：把“记忆面板”做成可追溯的复盘入口
summary: Doubao Work launched a traceable memory panel that lets users inspect the reasoning and evidence used during a task, alongside local Word editing and task-division updates. The report does not disclose retrieval, deletion, or security evaluation details.
summaryZh: 豆包工作上线可追溯的记忆面板，官方称用户可以查看 AI 执行任务时使用的思路与依据，便于核查和复盘；同期更新本地 Word 编辑和复杂任务分工体验。报道没有披露记忆检索、删除机制或安全评测。
why: “可追溯”是记忆产品化的关键交互，但需要看它能否解释和删除。

security.note: 强调可查看执行依据；报道未披露检索、删除与安全评测。

title: VAST Data Introduces New Foundation Stack for Secure, Production-Ready AI Agent Sandboxes with NVIDIA
titleZh: VAST + NVIDIA：把智能体状态和共享记忆做成基础设施
summary: VAST announced a foundation stack that separates durable agent state and shared memory services from ephemeral compute, allowing agents to pause, resume, or migrate while retaining context. Isolation, snapshots, and persistent activity audit are included; no independent memory-attack evaluation is provided.
summaryZh: VAST 与 NVIDIA 发布面向智能体沙箱的基础栈，把持久工作状态、共享记忆和临时计算环境分离，使智能体可以暂停、恢复或迁移而保留上下文。方案结合隔离工作区、快照和持久操作审计，属于记忆基础设施发布，没有提供记忆攻击防御效果的独立评测。
why: 把“记忆”作为有状态基础设施的一部分，而不是应用层插件。

security.note: 隔离工作区、快照与持久操作审计；未提供独立攻击评测。

title: Your AI Agent Remembers Everything. That Is Now Your Biggest Security and Compliance Problem.
titleZh: 当智能体什么都记得：一份记忆治理清单
summary: An engineering commentary discusses persistent memory poisoning and proposes separate readers and writers, provenance, scoped access, expiration, audit logs, and deletion workflows. It draws on external research rather than a new controlled experiment.
summaryZh: 一篇工程评论梳理外部邮件或网页被写入长期记忆后，攻击指令如何影响后续会话，并建议分离不可信内容读取与记忆写入、记录来源、隔离用户与任务、建立可验证删除流程。文中引用他人研究讨论风险，所列治理方案不是新的受控防御实验。
why: 治理清单完整，但属于评论文章，证据等级需降级。

security.note: 提出读写分离、来源、作用域、过期、审计与删除流程；引用他人研究。

title: 港科大团队：让Agent找回长对话中“失联的记忆”
titleZh: HeLa-Mem：用关联激活找回长对话里的线索
summary: HeLa-Mem organizes dialogue turns into an association graph; memories retrieved together strengthen their links, and semantic recall is combined with associative spreading. Reflection distills semantic knowledge and identifies stale candidates for forgetting.
summaryZh: 报道介绍 HeLa-Mem：把对话回合组织成关联图，共同被检索的记忆会加强连接，再结合语义召回和关联扩散找回措辞不同的历史线索。系统通过反思提炼语义知识并筛选遗忘候选，在 LoCoMo 上检验长对话记忆与上下文开销。
why: 中文报道里少见的机制细节：关联激活 + 语义检索 + 遗忘候选。

title: MemT 1.0发布：迈向递归自我改进，让记忆成为模型内生能力
titleZh: MemT 1.0：把记忆模块接进模型前向计算
summary: MemTensor released MemT-1.0-Flash and Nano with native memory blocks that update persistent states between turns. Training uses frozen backbone teachers and memory-specific optimization; reported evaluations cover memory tasks and coding experience reuse.
summaryZh: 记忆张量发布 MemT 1.0 系列，把可训练的记忆模块接入模型前向计算，用持续预训练和蒸馏学习历史信息的写入与读取，交互时更新持久记忆状态。报道介绍了记忆评测和编程经验复用实验；这不等于已经验证无限期递归自我改进。
why: “记忆成为内生能力”是一条值得跟踪的路线，但报道用词需要降级。

title: Memory for AI Agents Gets More Accurate: past.dev Reports the Highest Score Yet on DolphinBench
titleZh: past.dev 宣称 DolphinBench 最高分：厂商自测，待核验
summary: past.dev announced a self-run DolphinBench evaluation using Hermes Agent and GPT 5.6 Luna. The press release claims the highest published score for that configuration as of October 20; the result is vendor-reported and not independently reproduced here.
summaryZh: past.dev 公布采用 Hermes Agent 与 GPT 5.6 Luna 的 DolphinBench 自测结果，重点评估智能体能否依据历史信息采取正确行动，而不只是复述对话。新闻稿声称达到该配置截至 10 月 20 日的最高已公布成绩；这是厂商报告，本站不把它自动写入独立核验榜单。
why: 厂商自测的上榜声明，放在“待核验”而不是“结论”。
evidence: 厂商新闻稿 · 未经独立复现

title: 具身智能体长程记忆：看见不等于记住，浙大提出具身记忆基准
titleZh: EMem-Bench：具身记忆不只是“看见”
summary: Zhejiang University's OmniAI team introduces EMem-Bench, which tests embodied memory with observation, state change, action failure, and experience transfer tasks. EMem combines scene, spatial, and event memory so a robot can act on past evidence.
summaryZh: 浙江大学 OmniAI 团队的 EMem-Bench 用观察、状态变化、行动失败和经验迁移四类交互任务检验具身智能体的长期记忆；配套 EMem 系统把场景、空间和事件记忆结合起来，让机器人依据过去的证据行动。
why: 具身记忆评测从“记住画面”转向“用经历改进行动”。

title: Graphiti · mcp-v1.1.3
titleZh: Graphiti MCP 接口更新到 v1.1.3
summary: Graphiti's MCP interface is updated to v1.1.3. For agents using Graphiti as a temporal knowledge-graph memory layer, this is a tool-integration version change; see the release note for details.
summaryZh: Graphiti 的 MCP 接口更新到 v1.1.3。对使用 Graphiti 作为时间知识图谱记忆层的 Agent 来说，这是工具接入层的版本变化，具体变更以 release note 为准。
why: 官方发布，影响 MCP 接入；不含论文结论。

title: Graphiti · v0.31.2 - update certifi to mitigate eMudhra compromise
titleZh: Graphiti v0.31.2：更新 certifi 缓解证书链事件
summary: Graphiti v0.31.2 updates certifi to mitigate the eMudhra certificate-chain compromise. This is a dependency security update, not a memory-mechanism change; deployed Graphiti instances should check it first.
summaryZh: Graphiti v0.31.2 更新 certifi 以缓解 eMudhra 证书链事件的影响。属于依赖安全更新，不是记忆机制变化；部署了 Graphiti 的实例应优先核查。
why: 安全相关依赖更新，优先级高于普通功能发布。

security.note: 证书链依赖安全更新；具体影响以官方 release 为准。

title: Mem0 · Mem0 Node SDK (v3.3.1)
titleZh: Mem0 Node SDK v3.3.1
summary: Mem0 Node SDK v3.3.1 is released. Mem0 is a widely used persistent memory layer; SDK versions affect integration compatibility, so see the official release note for details.
summaryZh: Mem0 Node SDK 发布 v3.3.1。Mem0 是常用的持久记忆层，SDK 版本会影响接入方的 API 兼容性；具体变更以官方 release 为准。
why: 官方 SDK 发布，面向接入方。

title: Mem0 · Mem0 Python SDK (v2.2.1)
titleZh: Mem0 Python SDK v2.2.1
summary: Mem0 Python SDK v2.2.1 is released. It is relevant for tracking compatibility changes in a widely used memory-layer client; see the official release note for details.
summaryZh: Mem0 Python SDK 发布 v2.2.1。适合跟踪记忆层客户端的兼容性变化，具体变更以官方 release 为准。
why: 官方 SDK 发布。

title: MemGPT: Towards LLMs as Operating Systems
titleZh: MemGPT：把语言模型当成操作系统
summary: MemGPT borrows hierarchical memory management from operating systems, letting the model move information between limited context and external storage. It demonstrates state continuity in long documents and multi-session dialogue.
summaryZh: 借鉴操作系统的分层内存管理，让语言模型在有限上下文和外部存储之间主动移动信息。它在长文档处理和多会话对话中展示状态延续，是“LLM as OS”路线的早期代表。
why: 理解今天的分层记忆系统，需要回到这个起点。

title: MemoryBank: Enhancing Large Language Models with Long-Term Memory
titleZh: MemoryBank：让模型按遗忘曲线选择性回忆
summary: MemoryBank stores and updates user experiences and profiles for long-term interaction, adjusting memory strength over time and importance in a way inspired by forgetting curves, so the system can selectively recall and adapt.
summaryZh: 为长期交互保存并更新用户经历和画像，参考遗忘曲线按时间与重要性调整记忆强度，使系统能够选择性回忆并适应用户。
why: 把“遗忘”作为记忆系统的一等功能。

title: HippoRAG: Neurobiologically Inspired Long-Term Memory for Large Language Models
titleZh: HippoRAG：用知识图谱做多跳长期记忆
summary: HippoRAG combines knowledge graphs with associative retrieval, using a neurobiologically inspired design to support multi-hop long-term memory across dispersed text.
summaryZh: 把知识图谱和关联检索结合，用神经认知启发的方式支持多跳长期记忆，让分散在不同文本中的知识能够被连贯检索。
why: 图结构记忆与多跳检索的代表作。

title: Zep: A Temporal Knowledge Graph Architecture for Agent Memory
titleZh: Zep：用时间知识图谱组织智能体记忆
summary: Zep uses a temporal knowledge graph to organize agent memory, tracking entity relationships and how they change over time. It emphasizes updatable factual states and long-term retrieval.
summaryZh: 用时间知识图谱组织智能体记忆，跟踪实体关系及其随时间的变化，强调可更新的事实状态与长期检索。
why: 时间维度进入记忆图谱，和 Graphiti 的产品线相连。
evidence: 预印本 · 原文可核验

title: LongMemEval: Benchmarking Chat Assistants on Long-Term Interactive Memory
titleZh: LongMemEval：长期交互记忆的常用基准
summary: LongMemEval evaluates information extraction, multi-session reasoning, temporal reasoning, knowledge updates, and abstention in long-term interaction, and analyzes indexing, retrieval, and reading design.
summaryZh: 评测长期交互中的信息抽取、多会话推理、时间推理、知识更新和拒答能力，并分析记忆系统的索引、检索与读取设计。
why: 长期记忆评测的常用基准之一。

title: HaluMem: Evaluating Hallucinations in Memory Systems of Agents
titleZh: HaluMem：把记忆幻觉拆成抽取、更新与问答
summary: HaluMem evaluates memory hallucinations across extraction, update, and question answering, helping locate whether errors, conflicts, omissions, and fabrications arise in each operation.
summaryZh: 把记忆幻觉评测拆成抽取、更新和问答三个操作环节，帮助定位错误、冲突、遗漏和虚构究竟在哪一步产生。
why: 记忆幻觉不是单一问答指标，而是分阶段的系统问题。

title: A-MemGuard: A Proactive Defense Framework for LLM-Based Agent Memory
titleZh: A-MemGuard：用失败经验守住记忆
summary: A-MemGuard detects anomalies through reasoning consistency across related memories and stores failure lessons in a separate memory for pre-action checks, aiming to break the loop of malicious experience being recorded and reinforced.
summaryZh: 用相关记忆之间的推理一致性检测异常，并把失败教训存入独立记忆，在行动前检查。该设计旨在打断恶意经验被再次记录和强化的循环，防御范围以论文实验为准。
why: 把“失败经验”也当作需要治理的记忆。

security.note: 通过相关记忆的推理一致性检测异常，并将失败教训隔离存储。

evidence: 预印本 · 原文可核验

title: LongMemEval-V2: Evaluating Long-Term Agent Memory Toward Experienced Colleagues
titleZh: LongMemEval-V2：像有经验的同事一样工作
summary: LongMemEval-V2 evaluates whether agents accumulate reusable work experience across environment states, changes, workflows, pitfalls, and false premises. Evidence is provided to a fixed reader to focus evaluation on memory quality.
summaryZh: 围绕环境状态、变化、工作流程、陷阱和错误前提，评估智能体能否积累可复用的工作经验；系统先提供证据，再由固定 reader 回答，以聚焦记忆质量。
why: 从“记住对话”转向“像有经验的同事一样工作”。
evidence: 预印本 · 原文可核验
